citation.title: Standard Chartered Journey Credit Card (No Annual Fee)

extra.summary: Introducing the Standard Chartered Journey Credit Card – your ultimate companion for rewarding journeys and everyday expenses. Earn 3 miles per S$1 spent on transportation, food deliveries, and online groceries, making your daily commute and dining experiences even more rewarding. Earn 2 miles per S$1 for overseas spend, perfect for your international adventures. Plus, earn 1.2 miles per S$1 for local spends, ensuring you accumulate miles no matter where you are

annual-interest-rate-and-fees.Minimum Monthly Repayment: S$50 or 1% of Principal/ Interest, Fees & Charges/ Overlimit amount/ Past Due amount, whichever is higher

documents-required.SG Citizens or PRs:
Apply via MyInfo and prepare the following, 
1. Copy of Passport (6 months validity), and page with address displayed (where applicable), 
2. Copy of Employment Pass, 
3. Either one of the following: utility bill, tax bill, latest bank /credit card statement, rental agreement showing your address, latest mobile phone statement, letter from employer stating current address, government-issued document stating current address

our_takes.our-take: The Standard Chartered Journey Card stands out by rewarding both local and overseas spending. Earn up to 3 miles per S$1 on bonus categories like transport and food delivery, maximizing your returns on everyday expenses. Frequent travellers will appreciate the 2 complimentary Priority Pass lounge visits annually. Consider this card if you want a no-annual-fee option to accumulate miles, especially if your spending aligns with the bonus categories. A S$1,000 cap applies to bonus rewards, so high spenders may want to consider other cards.
our_takes.good-for:
Travellers seeking airport lounge access and complimentary travel insurance coverage for added peace of mind.
Individuals who frequently spend on transportation, food deliveries, and online groceries, maximizing rewards via bonus points.
Singaporeans earning at least S$30,000 annually, looking for a no-annual-fee travel card with KrisFlyer miles conversion.
our_takes.things-to-note:
Bonus points are capped at S$1,000 spend; exceeding this limit won't earn extra rewards.
A high 27.9% interest rate means carrying a balance will incur substantial charges each month.
While principal card has no annual fee, welcome bonus requires paying S$180 annually thereafter.
